lender_name.description: Name of the person/organization we borrowed from

lender_email.description: Email address of the lender for reminders

lender_phone.description: Phone number of the lender for contact

borrowed_date.description: Date when we acquired the item

received_by.description: Name of the person who received the item

due_date.description: Date when the item should be returned

returned_date.description: Actual date when the item was returned

returned_by.description: Name of the person who handled the return

status.description: Current status of the borrowed item

condition_borrowed.description: Condition when we received the item

condition_returned.description: Condition when we returned the item

deposit_returned.description: Whether the deposit has been returned

notes.description: Additional notes about the borrowing agreement

show_production.description: Show or production this item was borrowed for

reminder_sent.description: Whether a return reminder has been sent

tag_number.description: Temporary ID printed on the borrowed tag, e.g. LN-26-0007. Unique.

quantity.description: How many of this item were borrowed

pieces.description: Every separate piece that must come back (e.g. jacket, vest, 2 cufflinks)

lender_reference.description: The lender's own ID, invoice or loan number

replacement_value.description: Value the lender would charge if lost or damaged

agreement_on_file.description: Signed loan agreement / receipt is on file

lender_acknowledged_condition.description: Lender agreed with the condition noted at check-in

care_instructions.description: Special handling, cleaning or use restrictions

condition_notes_borrowed.description: Existing wear or damage noted at check-in

storage_location.description: Where the item is kept while we have it

returned_to.description: Person at the lender who took the item back

return_discrepancy.description: Something was missing or damaged at return
